title: [Textualize/rich] Fix issue #4211: negative set_cell_size truncation
description:
Fix GitHub issue #4211 in Textualize/rich:
https://github.com/Textualize/rich/issues/4211

Repo:
https://github.com/Textualize/rich

Target:
Move the total <= 0 guard ahead of the single-cell-width fast path in set_cell_size so negative totals return an empty string, and preserve or add focused regression coverage. Keep the change narrowly scoped.

- A real code change upstream against Textualize/rich.

- The final OpenJobs submission must include the commit hash, PR URL, and testing notes.

- Mention the exact OpenJobs listing ID or URL for this job in the PR body or a linked issue comment.
